title: The Handsome man at the door
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：handsome　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 handsome 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1949 the keeper wrote of ① a handsome man at the door in the calendar, and everybody in the tower said at once that it was ② more handsome than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the keeper, who never explained anything, had done it at once and gone home; it was the handsome ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most handsome man at the door anybody in the tower had ever seen, or so the calendar for January 1943 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too handsome to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the traveller who had come to help; the handsome ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a handsome sum for the work, and said that no traveller in his right mind would call it ⑥ as handsome as the sum for the work they had once had in the old tower. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was handsome or not, and he said so.

By 1956 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the calendar. What the line asked for was ⑦ something handsome, and nothing besides. The traveller from the next tower called the whole plan ⑧ quite handsome; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the calendar kept the names of the handsome ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1959, in the rain, she wrote of another handsome man at the door in the same calendar, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ more handsome than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most handsome sum for the work in the whole tower, she said in 1961, was the one she could never quite name; the handsome ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 英俊（前置定语 a handsome man at the door：1949 年守夜人在年历里记下的那件英俊的男人）
B. adj. 英俊／可观（比较级 more handsome than：文中两处，一处比门口那位英俊的男人，一处比预想）
C. adj. 英俊／可观（最高级 the most handsome：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 英俊（表语 too handsome to do：母亲觉得它太英俊，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 可观（前置定语 a handsome sum for the work：叔叔把整件事称作一桩可观的报酬）
F. adj. 可观（同级比较 as handsome as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩一笔可观的报酬相比）
G. adj. 可观（后置定语 something handsome：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 可观（受程度副词修饰 quite handsome：那位过路人的评价）

items.q: a handsome man at the door
the most handsome man at the door anybody
a handsome sum for the work
The most handsome sum for the work in

answers.why: handsome 意为“英俊”，1949 年守夜人在年历里记下的是“一件英俊的男人”，此处作前置定语 a handsome man at the door。
handsome 意为“英俊”，此处用比较级 more handsome than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
handsome 意为“英俊”，年历上 一月 那行字说它是钟楼里最英俊的一件，故用最高级 the most handsome man at the door。
handsome 意为“英俊”，母亲认为这件东西“太英俊了，谁也用不上”，too handsome to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
handsome 意为“可观”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩可观的报酬”，此处作前置定语 a handsome sum for the work。
handsome 意为“可观”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩一笔可观的报酬一样可观”，同级比较用 as handsome as。
handsome 意为“可观”，年历上那半行字要的是“可观的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something handsome。
handsome 意为“可观”，邻钟楼来的那位过路人认为这套计划“相当可观”，quite 修饰原级 handsome。
handsome 意为“可观”，1959 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要可观”，故用比较级 more handsome than。
handsome 意为“可观”，母亲 1961 年说的是“整个钟楼里最可观的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most handsome sum for the work。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1949 年，守夜人在年历里记下了一件英俊的男人。（a handsome man at the door）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更英俊。（more handsome than …）
母亲觉得它太英俊，谁也用不上。（too handsome to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩可观的报酬。（a handsome sum for the work）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩一笔可观的报酬一样可观。（as handsome as …）
到了 1956 年，年历上只剩半行字：要的是一件可观的东西。（something handsome）
answers: In 1949 the keeper wrote of a handsome man at the door in the calendar.
Everybody said it was more handsome than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too handsome to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a handsome sum for the work.
He said nobody would call it as handsome as the sum for the work they had once had.
By 1956 the calendar asked for nothing but something handsome.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 handsome 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1949 the keeper wrote of a handsome man at the door in the calendar, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most handsome man at the door in the tower, or so the calendar says.
My mother thought it too handsome to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a handsome sum for the work, and nobody argued with him.
The traveller from the next tower called the plan quite handsome, and everybody laughed.
The handsome ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
